subjects.title: ZIA Rule Labels
subjects.lead: A rule label is an organizational group for policy rules: the feature has two parts, creating labels and associating them with policy rules.

subjects.title: ZIA rule label API surface
subjects.lead: The OpenAPI contract defines list and create on `/ruleLabels` and get, update and delete on `/ruleLabels/{ruleLabelId}`.

subjects.title: ZIA rule label limits and constraints
subjects.lead: The Ranges & Limitations page lists "Rule Labels" at 1,024 labels, in the group of limits headed "All Policy Rule Types".

subjects.title: Deleting a ZIA rule label
subjects.lead: The help text states that a rule label can be deleted only if it is not associated with any policy rule.

subjects.title: Which ZIA rule types accept rule labels
subjects.lead: The ZIA Terraform provider documents a `labels` attribute on fifteen rule resources: firewall filtering, firewall DNS, firewall IPS, NAT control, traffic cap...
